title: RepoAssure Multi-Repo Workspace Repair Summary Contract Implementation v0.1
objective: Implement the local-only multi-repo workspace repair summary contract in @hardening-mcp/acceptance, producing deterministic JSON and Markdown artifacts from the existing workspace manifest and per-repository repair task packages without adding CLI or MCP entrypoints, executing commands, applying patches, or writing target repositories.
acceptance: Implement typed workspace summary contracts and a package-owned generator under @hardening-mcp/acceptance.
Generate deterministic workspace-repair-summary.json and workspace-repair-summary.md artifacts from a valid workspace manifest and per-repository latest repair task packages.

Implement repository states, workspace statuses, deterministic P0/P1/P2 ordering, structural stale detection, missing and invalid artifact diagnostics, identity-collision fail-closed behavior, AI IDE read order, maintainer review, shared redaction, and no-write proof.
Add unit and integration pyramid coverage with multiple non-private repository fixtures and target source content, mtime, and directory-listing preservation.
Do not add CLI or MCP entrypoints, execute verification commands, apply patches, write target repositories, or implement Team Cloud or hosted dashboard capabilities.
Cascade implementation evidence through canonical docs, testing and acceptance records, logs, and Autopilot state, then select at most one bounded next Goal.
